aboutH2: 1000 Islands Addiction Rehab & Treatment Centre: Inpatient Rehab in the Thousand Islands
intro: The 1000 Islands Addiction Rehab & Treatment Centre is a leading drug and alcohol rehab located in the Thousand Islands region of Ontario. The facility offers a comprehensive range of addiction treatment programs tailored to meet the needs of individuals seeking to overcome substance abuse problems.

One of the key services provided by the 1000 Islands Addiction Rehab & Treatment Centre is its inpatient drug and alcohol rehabilitation program. This full-service program is designed to provide intensive and individualized care to patients in a supportive and healing environment. Inpatient care allows patients to receive comprehensive therapy and counseling, as well as participate in group therapies, yoga, meditation, art therapy and other activities that are aimed at promoting sobriety.

The inpatient program at the 1000 Islands Addiction Rehab & Treatment Centre is staffed by a team of experienced and qualified professionals who are dedicated to helping patients achieve long-term recovery. The facility is equipped with state-of-the-art medical facilities, including round-the-clock medical care and support, to ensure that patients receive the best possible care during their stay.

Overall, the 1000 Islands Addiction Rehab & Treatment Centre is committed to providing patients with the tools and resources they need to overcome their substance abuse problems and achieve lasting sobriety. Whether you are seeking help for yourself or a loved one, the facility’s inpatient drug and alcohol rehabilitation program is an excellent option for those looking for comprehensive and personalized care in a supportive and healing environment.

pillars.title: A Waterfront Property on the St. Lawrence River
pillars.body: The centre is on the Thousand Islands Parkway near Mallorytown, with its own stretch of shoreline on the St. Lawrence River. A dock and a small bay are used for swimming in the warmer months, and there are walking areas along the water and a firepit circle set back against the trees. Men and women live in separate residences, and the nursing building, gym, pool room and volleyball courts are all on the same grounds. Brockville is about 20 minutes east and Gananoque about 25 minutes west, so the property feels rural without being cut off.

pillars.title: Aftercare That Starts Before Discharge
pillars.body: Planning for home is part of the treatment plan, and aftercare picks up when the residential stay ends. You keep access to a support line at any hour of the day or night, and staff keep checking on your progress. The team helps you find a 12-step or other support group in your area, refers you to local therapists and counsellors, and runs education for the family members who will be supporting you. Recovery.com adds that this includes weekly aftercare groups, on site or online, and a weekly check-in with an addiction counsellor for the first month.

pillars.title: A CARF-Accredited Team of Nurses, Doctors and Counsellors
pillars.body: The staff at 1000 Islands includes nurses, a physician and certified addiction counsellors, and the centre says it has more than 40 certified specialists. Stacey Ferland leads clinical operations, and Dr. Mike Horsey is the centre's medical doctor. The centre earned CARF accreditation in August 2023, the same year it became part of Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres, a national group of inpatient and outpatient programs.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does 1000 Islands Addiction Rehab & Treatment Centre cost?
faqs.a: The centre does not publish its fees, and its recovery.com profile lists no prices either, so you need to call admissions at (855) 929-4045 for a quote. Ask what is included in the residential stay, detox and aftercare when you call.

The core residential program runs 42 days, according to the centre's recovery.com profile, and some clients stay longer when they need more time. There is also a virtual program of 4 or 6 weeks. The centre's own website does not list program lengths, so confirm the plan with admissions.

faqs.q: Does the centre offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Detox is supervised on site under a doctor's care, and clients move straight from detox into residential treatment. The centre says detox usually takes anywhere from a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on the substance and the person's health.

faqs.q: Where is the centre located and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 853 Thousand Islands Parkway in Mallorytown, Ontario, on the St. Lawrence River between Brockville and Gananoque. Most people drive in along Highway 401: it is about 3 hours from Toronto, about an hour and a half from Ottawa and around 40 minutes from Kingston. Recovery.com lists airport transfers as an amenity, so ask admissions about pickup.

You keep access to the centre's support line at any hour, and staff continue to check on your progress after discharge. The team helps you find a 12-step or other support group near home, refers you to local therapists and counsellors, and offers education for family members. All alumni can take part in aftercare programming.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a private residential centre and treatment is not provincially funded. Recovery.com says the centre accepts payment through insurers that cover non-provincially funded inpatient or virtual addiction treatment, naming GreenShield, Sun Life, Manulife, Desjardins, RBC and Blue Cross plans. Check your own coverage with your insurer or employer plan before admission.
